svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Jig's line: seven stations in a loop, then two slots and the wall
svg.desc: An engraved isometric floor. Seven stations stand around a closed track: Pick up, Build, Open, Drive, Repair, Merge and Follow up, which feeds back to Pick up. Merge is a person's station. One work item travels the track and waits at Merge. Then the floor is set again: one account pad with two slots, each holding a work item, and a third item waiting in front of a wall across the lane.
